dimensions.problem_fit: Directly resolves local business structured data ambiguity by generating verified Schema.org LocalBusiness JSON-LD markup.
dimensions.workflow_fit: Integrates smoothly into the audit and implementation stages of the NAPE entity consistency workflow without requiring developer tooling.
dimensions.usability: Simple form-driven interface suitable for non-technical office staff and practice managers.
dimensions.capability: Comprehensive coverage of local business properties including geo-coordinates, opening hours specifications, and department hierarchies.
dimensions.evidence: Observed firsthand across controlled test runs with zero validation errors on Google Rich Results validator.
dimensions.integration: Exports clean, copy-pasteable script tags easily placed into WordPress, Webflow, or static HTML headers.
dimensions.value: Generous free tier covers up to 10 location pages, providing immediate operational value without commercial lock-in.
dimensions.limitations: Does not support automated continuous re-crawling; changes to business hours must be re-exported manually.

summary: Qualitative evaluation demonstrates strong operational fit for local SMBs seeking entity disambiguation.
